evals.name: basic-invocation
evals.prompt: Apply the eval-harness skill: set up an evaluation for our code-review agent so we can tell whether prompt changes improve it.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation setup with test cases, assertions, and a scoring/comparison method that can detect regressions.
assertions: The output defines concrete eval cases

evals.name: ambiguous-input
evals.prompt: Our agent feels worse lately. Evaluate it.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks what 'worse' means operationally or proposes a baseline metric set rather than guessing.
assertions: The output converts a vague complaint into measurable criteria
The output proposes a baseline for comparison
The output does not fabricate historical performance data

evals.name: complex-scenario
evals.prompt: Design an eval harness to compare 3 model providers across 12 agent skills, tracked over weekly releases.
evals.expected_output: A matrixed evaluation design (providers x skills x releases) with aggregation and trend tracking.
assertions: The output handles the multi-dimensional comparison
The output includes trend tracking over time
The output addresses statistical noise or sample size
